$comment: FICTIONAL SAMPLE. Alex Rivera, Tailspin Analytics, every employer and every number here is invented for demonstration.
name: Alex Rivera
roleLine: Why the Senior Data Engineer role at Tailspin Analytics fits
fitStatement: Six years building batch and streaming pipelines on **AWS**, on the stack this posting names: **Spark**, **Airflow**, **Snowflake** and **dbt**, with **Kafka** ingestion and **Terraform** infrastructure. Owns the data quality tests behind finance and operations reporting. Two requirements are met only in part, Unity Catalog governance and on-call leadership, and are marked partial below rather than rounded up.

checks.label: Experience band 5+ years
checks.text: six years in data roles, March 2023 to date as Senior Data Engineer

checks.label: Preferred
checks.text: Delta Lake, mentoring and CI/CD, all in register

checks.label: Certifications
checks.text: AWS Data Engineer Associate and SnowPro Core, held

requirements.evidence: Data Engineer since June 2020 and Senior Data Engineer since March 2023, after two years as a data analyst.
**PySpark** jobs on 2.5 TB a day; **SQL** linting in CI; Python automation that replaced a 6-hour manual report.
Built **PySpark** jobs on AWS EMR processing 2.5 TB of claims data a day into Delta Lake tables.
Runs 60+ **Airflow** pipelines with retries, SLAs and alerting; on-time delivery rose from 91% to 99.4%.
Layered **dbt** project of 140 models on **Snowflake**; warehouse spend cut 31% through clustering and incremental models.
Moved shipment events from nightly files to **Kafka** streams; dashboard freshness went from 24 hours to 6 minutes.

requirements.requirement: AWS (S3, Glue or EMR) and infrastructure as code with Terraform
requirements.evidence: Codified warehouse, S3 and Glue resources as **Terraform** modules with plans on every pull request.

requirements.requirement: Ownership of data quality testing and monitoring
requirements.evidence: **Data quality** tests on all 140 dbt models; failed-load incidents fell from about 9 a month to 2.
Writes **Delta Lake** tables with schema enforcement on EMR.
requirements.note: Unity Catalog itself is not yet on the record.

requirements.requirement: Leads on-call for the data platform
requirements.evidence: Airflow SLAs and alerting are his to maintain.
requirements.note: He takes part in the rotation; he has not led it.

requirements.requirement: Mentoring other engineers; CI/CD for data projects
requirements.evidence: Mentors two engineers through review and pairing; GitHub Actions run tests and Terraform plans on every change.
